description: Tangliengim (TLI) tone sandhi, Taipei standard. The one source for the Python engines (desktop/tangliengim_engine.py, desktop/hokkien_tone_marker_gui.py); shared/web-ime-core.js mirrors it and tests/test_dictionary_orthography_spec.py keeps them equal. Tones are TLI tone digits. The Hangul spells Hokkien, not Korean.

sandhiToCitation.comment: Sandhi tone 3 is ambiguous (citation 4 and 5 both become 3); a new entry follows the 1→5→3→2→1 cycle and defaults back to citation 5.
